our_method_vs_primary.metric: sun-attributable normalized lit/shadow albedo gap change, same scene as EXP0019/EXP0024, swept over 200/400/600/1000-step budgets
our_method_vs_primary.verdict: at the best-observed budget (400 steps), one of two heldout views (view9, 0.74pp) is already smaller in magnitude than SGS-Intrinsic's -1.20pp; the other (view3, 0.83pp) is still larger than SGS's -0.43pp -- a mixed, not a clean, win. Non-monotonic across step counts, so 400 steps is an observed best point from an exploratory sweep, not a validated/tuned setting. All tested budgets closed most of the gap from vanilla IRIS. 1 room/1 seed/oracle sun direction -- see SUNPATCH_DAYLIGHT_METHOD_ZH.md for the full honest scope
